page.overview:
What is Genesect Army?

The Genesect Army is a group of four Genesect lead by the Red Genesect in Genesect and the Legend Awakened. They were part of Team Plasma's "Project G".

The Genesect Army was restored from five ancient fossils and has cannons attached to their backs by Team Plasma.
